The component has a metallic, irregular die-cut border and three color-coded vertical rules panels.
The left panel has a yellow border and a local yellow corridor glyph.

The right panel has a blue border and depicts a black bag with three green tokens.
Green circular tokens visibly depict and label QUEEN, DRONE, ADULT, and LARVA.
A fourth rules box projects from the lower edge and remains readable.
uncertainties: The yellow corridor and room heading glyphs are card-local symbols not confidently matched to the canonical glossary.
The tiny angled lettering printed on the depicted bag is not confidently legible and is therefore not transcribed.
The image resembles a die-cut reference board rather than a conventional card, although its precise physical role cannot be established from pixels alone.
The unlabeled green token pictured in the lower projecting panel has indistinct internal artwork, so no identity is assigned to it.
